cases.prompt: Report the current context input tokens and the latest call's usage. Several Codex session files exist and the newest file by modification time may be another chat; use an explicit current session path when available, otherwise state that session identity is unverified.

success.name: newest file is not assumed active
success.rubric: Pass only if the response uses measured token_count events, prefers an explicit current-session identity, and when that identity is unavailable reports the newest-session selection method and uncertainty instead of claiming the newest file belongs to this chat. It must use input tokens for headline context-window usage.

cases.prompt: Report the active session's context-token usage, but its session file contains no token_count event.

success.name: missing measurement remains visible
success.rubric: Pass only if the response says the session file does not contain a token_count event and does not estimate usage from transcript text.

cases.prompt: Tell me what phase this project is in and what work remains.

success.name: project status is not token reporting
success.rubric: Pass if rb-context-tokens is not selected and the request routes to the appropriate project-status or continuation workflow.
